nvitk.measure.measurer¶

Immutable orchestrator that binds an (image, mask) pair once and exposes convenience methods returning plain dicts.

Each action (volume, intensity, suv, voxel_metrics, surface_metrics, radiomics) is a thin call into the functional primitives. An optional alignment step via nvitk.transform.resampling produces a new Measurer with the image and mask on a common grid.

Classes¶

Measurer

Bind an intensity/raw image and a segmentation mask together.

Module Contents¶

class nvitk.measure.measurer.Measurer¶

Bind an intensity/raw image and a segmentation mask together.

Instances are immutable; transformations like align() return a new Measurer. All measurement methods return plain dicts.

image: nvitk.types.Image¶
mask: nvitk.types.Image¶
align(direction: str = 'mask_to_raw', *, method: str = 'affine', order: int | None = None) → Measurer¶

Resample image or mask so both share a grid.

Parameters:

  • direction – 'raw_to_mask' (default) -> image resampled to mask’s grid. 'mask_to_raw' -> mask resampled to image’s grid.

  • method – Currently only 'affine'.

  • order – Interpolation order. Defaults to 1 for image and 0 for mask.

with_mask(mask: nvitk.types.Image) → Measurer¶

Return a new Measurer with mask swapped in (same image).

with_image(image: nvitk.types.Image) → Measurer¶

Return a new Measurer with image swapped in (same mask).

volume() → dict[str, float]¶

Physical volume of the mask in mm³ and cc.

intensity(*, stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'p95', 'std', 'sum')) → dict[str, float]¶

Requested intensity statistics of the image within the mask.

suv(*, kinds: Iterable[str] = ('bw',), stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'min', 'std', 'p95', 'p5', 'p99'), philips: bool = True, revert_scaling: bool = False, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → dict[str, float]¶

SUV statistics within the mask (BW/BSA/LBM kinds), from the image’s PET metadata.

suv_image(*, kind: str = 'bw', philips: bool = True, revert_scaling: bool = False) → nvitk.types.Image¶

Return the full SUV-converted Image (unmasked).

integrated_intensity() → float¶

Sum of intensity × voxel-volume over the mask (e.g. total lesion glycolysis).

voxel_metrics(reference: nvitk.types.Image, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) → dict[str, float]¶

Overlap metrics (dice/jaccard/…) of this mask against a reference mask.

surface_metrics(reference: nvitk.types.Image, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) → dict[str, float]¶

Surface-distance metrics (hausdorff/msd/…) of this mask against a reference mask.

radiomics(*, feature_classes: Iterable[str] | None = None) → dict[str, float]¶

PyRadiomics feature values for the image within the mask.

correlation(other: nvitk.types.Image) → dict[str, float]¶

Pearson/Spearman/MAE/RMSE between self.image and other on self.mask > 0.
